**merge-train (2026-11-22): on this train.** Validated at `1abeb4074`. `gemini-nano-banana-2.1` is confirmed on Google's deprecations page and via `models.get`; `/review` and `/cso --diff` are clean, and the new test drives the request URL. Thank you!

One mechanical commit pushed to your branch as `07a645337` (docs and comments only, no code):
- `docs/memory/feature-flows/image-generation.md` and `agent-avatars.md` still named "Gemini 3.1 Flash Image Preview". They now name the `GEMINI_IMAGE_MODEL` model, and `GEMINI_IMAGE_MODEL` is listed in the Configuration section.
- `.env.example`: the override comment said "both default to gemini-3.5-flash"; it now covers the third variable and its different default.
- `tests/unit/test_image_generation_service.py:65`: the comment cites #4717 (it said #4949, which doesn't exist).

I approved this fork's CI runs. Note for the release: the default image model changes for installs that don't set the variable.
